what.text: This page follows refugees from Czechia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 366 refugees from Czechia in Germany, 46.1% of all refugees from Czechia.
Germany is the largest host of refugees from Czechia, followed by Canada, France and Denmark.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Czechia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 5935 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
